description: Calculate a sourdough bread recipe in grams from loaf count, loaf size and hydration. Returns flour, water, starter and salt, plus a link to the same recipe on loafy.ai where the baker can adjust it and run the timers. Pizza dough is calculate_pizza_dough, and when to start a bake is plan_sourdough_bake. A value outside its range is corrected, and notes name it.

hydration_percent.description: Water as a percentage of flour. The book recommends around 60 % for most flours; higher is more open but stickier.

loaf_size_g.description: Flour per loaf in grams, not the dough weight: 500 g of flour makes one standard loaf of about 860 g of dough. For a loaf of a given dough weight, the flour is about 58 % of it at 60 % hydration.

whole_grain_percent.description: Share of the flour that is whole grain, the rest is bread flour.

name: calculate_bread_dough

outputSchema.description: A sourdough bread recipe in grams.

dough_per_loaf_g.description: The dough of one loaf, in grams.

input.description: The arguments as the tool used them, after any correction.

note.description: A remark on the whole result, such as why nothing was found.

notes.description: What was corrected or left out, such as a value outside its range.

url.description: The same answer, recipe or entry on loafy.ai.

title: Bread dough calculator
